besluite.rede: 'sy' clearly points back to the wetland in the previous sentence and reads naturally; 'die' is only a lateral move.
'by 'n vleiland inkom' is plain, natural Afrikaans, and 'by ... instroom' is no better and slightly odd with 'by'.
Leaving out the verb of motion after a modal ('moet ... deur') is standard Afrikaans, so supplying 'deurvloei' is a lateral move.

besluite.fout: The 'en' joins two contrasting halves flatly, so the limit on what a wetland does is easy to miss.
besluite.rede: 'maar dit' makes the contrast explicit with the correct AWS comma, and the actors, actions and negation stay exactly the same.
The trailing 'op twee maniere' sets up 'Eerstens ... Tweedens' well, and moving it next to 'ook' makes the sentence less clear.
The original keeps the wetland as subject, parallel with the sponge sentence before it; fronting the time phrase is only a lateral reorder.

besluite.fout: 'gelyk' can be read as 'level' or 'equal' here instead of 'at the same time'.
besluite.rede: 'tegelyk' is the standard word for 'at the same time', so it removes the ambiguity without changing the meaning or touching a protected wording.
